elements.label: Network service map (camera pushes in toward the hovered service)
Unrelated service nodes dimming (auth-dotnet as representative)
Service hover tooltip with flow metrics

pattern.description: As a service node is hovered, its metrics tooltip appears and every unrelated node and edge fades to a pale ghost, leaving the focused service and its connections at full colour while the camera pushes in about 1.35x; the 'From millions of network flows' caption stays fixed.
pattern.why_premium: Dimming the context and zooming together cuts a dense, unreadable graph down to one legible path without removing the surrounding network, so scale and focus read at the same time.

build_hint.gsap: tl.to('.tooltip', {opacity: 1, duration: 0.15}); tl.to('.node:not(.related), .edge:not(.related)', {opacity: 0.25, filter: 'saturate(0.4)', duration: 0.35, ease: 'power2.out'}, '<'); tl.fromTo('.map-layer', {scale: 1}, {scale: 1.36, xPercent: -5, yPercent: -2, transformOrigin: '55% 60%', duration: 0.5, ease: 'expo.out'}, '<'); caption on an unscaled layer.
build_hint.remotion: const p = spring({frame, fps, config: {damping: 30, stiffness: 120, mass: 1}}); map scale interpolate(p,[0,1],[1,1.36]); unrelated opacity interpolate(frame,[0,10],[1,0.25],{easing: Easing.out(Easing.quad)}); tooltip opacity interpolate(frame,[0,4],[0,1]).

notes: Two motions overlap: spotlight dimming and a camera push_in (scale 1.36). spotlight_focus chosen over ui_camera_push_in because the dimming is the distinctive part; either is defensible. No whole-node candidate box for the focused red service, so it is not listed.
